subsystemBreakdown.summary: CPP-vs-TS SCREENS + top-level layout audit report. TS source-of-truth covered: FullscreenLayout.tsx (637), Messages.tsx (834), LogoV2/LogoV2.tsx (542), LogoV2/WelcomeV2.tsx (432). CPP audited: ui/screens/repl_screen.cppm (2829), ui/layout/fullscreen_layout.cppm (291), ui/layout/logo.cppm (424), ui/messages/messages_list.cppm (1728), ui/prompt/prompt_input_footer.cppm (603), ui/app.cppm thin adapter (2988). Totals: 21 features ALIGNED structurally / visually, 6 P0 BLOCKER, 13 P1 VISIBLE, 9 P2 MINOR, 7 P3 INFO. User-requested files BriefLayout/BriefSpinner/BriefPrompt/Home/Welcome/Welcomes/WelcomeNotice/Logo(TS legacy)/Toolbar do NOT exist in the TS repo tree (confirmed by find). Brief* features are guarded by feature(KAIROS_BRIEF) in Messages.tsx via conditional require; CPP side has no KAIROS pipeline so they correctly don't render — no misalignment attributable to migration. Top P0s: (1) 7-stage message grouping/collapse/lookup pipeline absent, (2) VirtualMessageList absent (last-N=80 only), (3) LogoV2 compact/full render modes + FeedColumn missing (only condensed), (4) WelcomeV2 58-col starfield + Clawd missing, (5) in-transcript unseen divider missing, (6) transcript/brief/truncation filter tiers missing.

Full audit of 37 TS message renderer components vs 33 CPP modules. Inventory: TS has 35 rendering components (2 helpers excluded). CPP has 33 files: 27 rendering modules + 6 list-framework/shared modules. Faithful-port coverage: 15 components have parity via `Render*Faithful()` entry points. Gaps: 11 P2-level (missing module stubs), 4 P1 (faithful renderer data-flow not wired), 7 P3 (divergent-only). Key divergences: the divergent `Component` classes add chrome not in TS (borders, footers, emojis, timestamps) — these are kept for interactive UX but the faithful Element factories exist per M4. High-risk gaps: UserPromptMessage 10K-char truncation missing, UserLocalCommandOutput faithful wrapper absent from repl_screen, SystemAPIErrorMessage no retry hook, teamMemCollapsed module stub missing.

CPP-vs-TS Prompt/Input Widget full-dimension audit across: prompt prefix glyphs (❯/!), vim mode indicators, autocomplete sources (@file/@agent/@mcp/@history/@templates/skills), keyboard bindings (emacs/Ctrl+J/K/Shift+Enter/Ctrl+C/Esc), 4-tier placeholder cascade, clipboard paste (10K truncation + PNG/JPEG preview), combinedHighlights 8-tier painter's algorithm, and footer widgets (mode pills/exit double-tap/stable-height/narrow stack/help menu/notifications/proactive countdown/PR badge/sandbox/voice/todos). 45 findings total: P0-BLOCKER=3 (enum fragmentation, prefix glyph split, placeholder cascade missing), P1-VISIBLE=12 (vim impl conflict, 5 autocomplete sources absent, paste truncation, bash prefix leak, combined highlights absent, image paste missing, stash restore missing, mcp suggestions unwired, permission shift-tab unwired), P2-MINOR=20 (emacs bindings, Ctrl+J/K ac nav, Shift+Enter, Ctrl+C gates, Esc wire, slash arg hint, help menu placeholder, exit double-tap state, pasting indicator, queued edit hint, notifications stub, coordinator panel, bridge fullscreen gate, vim status bar duplicate, proactive countdown, history substring highlight, viewport windowing, voice indicator, sandbox hint, teammate prefix color), P3-INFO=3 (PR badge, selection copy hint, todos shortcut override), ALIGNED=7 (statusline ANSI parser, declared cursor, undo/redo stack, Ctrl+R overlay, Tab navigation, footer stable height fullscreen, narrow <80 col stack).

Audited 216 comparison points across 3 axes: DIALOG coverage (51 TS dialogs vs 39+16 CPP files), DESIGN TOKENS (4 palette variants × 27 tokens × rainbow = 108 color pairs), and FIGURES (3 constants sources × spinner frames × npm-figures glyph set = ~40 glyphs). Result: 78 ALIGNED (36%), 5 P2-MINOR, 6 P1-VISIBLE, 1 ALIGNED-in-spirit architectural note.

DIALOGS: 51 TS dialogs catalogued — 39 (76%) have CPP equivalents; 12 are missing (low-impact: InvalidConfig/InvalidSettings/ChannelDowngrade/ApproveApiKey, higher-impact: TeamsDialog gated on AGENT_TRIGGERS feature flag, WorkflowMultiselectDialog, UltrareviewOverage, BypassPermissionsMode, AutoUpdater, DevChannels, ClaudeMdIncludes, ConfigurableShortcutHint). 16 CPP dialog-infrastructure modules have no direct TS 1:1 (DialogQueue, render pipeline aggregators, sub-views) — intentional FTXUI layout scaffolding, ALIGNED in spirit. One specific dialog (permission_dialog.cppm) remains string-rendered with hardcoded ANSI, unlike TS PermissionDialog.tsx which uses theme.resolve_color through Ink — P2, in-file DEFERRED comment present.

COLORS (dark theme): 10/20 base tokens correctly aligned byte-for-byte (success, warning, danger, muted, subtle, suggestion, text, user_message_background, message_actions_background, primary/CLAWDED). 11/20 P1-VISIBLE: info/permission is sky-blue (110,151,255) vs TS lavender (177,185,249), diff_added/diff_removed use bright greens/reds instead of TS saturated dark shades, inverse_text/app chrome = rgb(32,33,36) vs pure black, merged purple has small delta, both rate_limit_* tokens are visibly different, and CLAWDED_SHIM has minor 3/5/7 drift. Rainbow palette uses Chart.js defaults, not TS ultrathin rainbow — all 7 elements P1. Light palette: 17/20 P1-VISIBLE (only 3 aligned). Daltonized palettes: all 27 compared tokens P1 (values computed via matrix approximation instead of verbatim TS rgb literals). 42 TS Theme fields are absent from the CPP Palette struct: autoAccept, bashBorder, 8 subagent colors, 2 diff dimmed, promptBorder(+Shimmer), memoryBackgroundColor, selectionBg, userMessageBackgroundHover, professionalBlue, planMode, remember, fastMode, inactiveShimmer, permissionShimmer, warningShimmer, 7 rainbow shimmers, clawd_background, briefLabelClaude/You, chromeYellow, ide. 14 shimmer tokens — only 2 exist in Palette struct (primary_shimmer, rainbow_shimmer) so permissionShimmer / inactiveShimmer / warningShimmer / promptBorderShimmer / fastModeShimmer / claudeBlueShimmer / 7 rainbow shimmers are absent.

FIGURES: cc.constants.figures.cppm is byte-perfect (platform-gated BLACK_CIRCLE, correct Unicode escapes, BRIDGE_SPINNER_FRAMES array, correct BRIDGE_READY_INDICATOR with variation selector). Second module ui.components/figures.cppm has 3 defects: no platform fallback for BLACK_CIRCLE, missing BRIDGE_SPINNER_FRAMES array, wrong checkmark glyph in BRIDGE_READY_INDICATOR. npm `figures` default-export glyph set (18 commonly-used keys: pointer '❯', cross '✘', tick '✔', warning '⚠', pointerSmall '›', info 'ℹ', circle '◯', ellipsis '…', checkboxOn '☒', checkboxOff '☐', hamburger '☰', bullet '●', etc.) has no centralized CPP constant file — glyphs exist ad-hoc with wrong bytes (e.g. '✓' U+2713 used throughout instead of figures.tick '✔' U+2714, '✗' U+2717 used instead of figures.cross '✘' U+2718, '>' used for pointer in MessageSelector instead of '❯' U+276F). Spinner frames: component_primitives 10-frame braille matches TS SpinnerGlyph, but tool_use_loader and thinking_message both truncate to 8 frames (dropping '⠇⠏'), and messages_list uses a distinct 10-frame asterisk-variant sweep for the envelope spinner — unclear if intentional divergence or mismatch.

SCOPE DISTRIBUTION: 7 single-file fixes (design_tokens.cppm palette lines, ui/components/figures.cppm), 3 multi-file (spinner frame standardization, migrate ui.components.figures to cc.constants.figures, dialog coverage gaps), 2 requires-engine-wiring (npm-figures glyph constants + import sites, 42 missing Theme palette fields). All color P1-VISIBLE fixes are contained in cpp_migration/src/ui/design_system/design_tokens.cppm lines 138-277 (4 palette struct literal blocks).

CPP-vs-TS audit: 254 items across Commands/Tools/MCP/API/LSP/Skills/Tasks/Hooks; 169 aligned; 46 gaps (1 P0 3P-auth, 9 P1, 27 P2, 3 P3, 6 ALIGNED markers).
